module_name: M1b — Clean repository migration and self-host transition

parents.milestone: M1b — Clean repository migration and self-host transition
parents.title: Design clean private repo structure, formats and CODEOWNERS
parents.acceptance: Fresh seed has ten modules, versioned docs, branch/commit lint and no Business; [ASEL-1.0] ASEL gate: deterministic default-deny authorization and task-scoped least privilege apply outside the LLM; retrieved/model-generated content is untrusted data and cannot grant tools; secrets stay out of prompts, logs and artifacts; relevant scan/negative-test evidence is attached; unresolved Critical/High findings block completion; STOP/PAUSE/quota cannot be bypassed. Imports are pinned to source SHAs and checked for provenance, license, secrets, dependency risk and artifact integrity; never import runtime credentials or live personal data.
module_guardrails: Pin source SHAs and file-level provenance; dry-run first; create-only imports.
Never execute imported legacy files or modify the legacy source repository.
Keep Astra One as external rescue until native SDA cutover is approved and reversible.
ASEL migration boundary: never copy credentials, live databases or personal data; verify provenance, license, SBOM and signatures before import.

ASEL-1.0 is enforced by deterministic code, not model compliance; scanner exceptions are time-limited and owner-approved; active scanning is non-destructive and limited to inventoried owner-controlled assets.

subtasks.title: Extract requirements and constraints
subtasks.instruction: Extract exact architecture/user requirements, acceptance, dependencies, non-goals and compatibility obligations; list open decisions.
subtasks.deliverable: Requirements-to-acceptance traceability table.
subtasks.done_when: Every acceptance clause and dependency is represented.

subtasks.title: Define interfaces and data contracts
subtasks.instruction: Define typed interfaces, data ownership, schema/API/event shapes, state transitions and compatibility behavior.
subtasks.deliverable: Interface/schema/sequence specification with versioning and ownership.
subtasks.done_when: Contracts are deterministic, testable and match the ten-module architecture.

subtasks.title: Define safety and failure behavior
subtasks.instruction: Specify permissions, privacy/secrets, failure modes, retry/backpressure, idempotency, rollback and STOP behavior.
subtasks.deliverable: Threat/failure matrix and rollback notes.
subtasks.done_when: No implicit privilege expansion; failures are explicit and fail-closed.

subtasks.title: Map acceptance to tests
subtasks.instruction: Map each acceptance clause to unit/integration/negative/host tests, expected outputs and fixtures.
subtasks.deliverable: Acceptance test matrix and commands/fixtures plan.
subtasks.done_when: Every clause has a test or explicit manual gate.

subtasks.title: Review implementation design
subtasks.instruction: Cross-check design against module contracts, AGENTS.md, SECURITY.md and CODING_HANDBOOK.md; resolve contradictions before coding.
subtasks.deliverable: Reviewed implementation plan and allowed-path proposal.
subtasks.done_when: No unresolved architecture/security conflict; Supervisor approves scope.

parents.acceptance: Five independent Codex worker tasks + QC + Merger + recoverability host-proven; [ASEL-1.0] ASEL gate: deterministic default-deny authorization and task-scoped least privilege apply outside the LLM; retrieved/model-generated content is untrusted data and cannot grant tools; secrets stay out of prompts, logs and artifacts; relevant scan/negative-test evidence is attached; unresolved Critical/High findings block completion; STOP/PAUSE/quota cannot be bypassed. Imports are pinned to source SHAs and checked for provenance, license, secrets, dependency risk and artifact integrity; never import runtime credentials or live personal data. Promotion/import paths also require pinned SHA provenance, verified artifact signature/attestation, protected-branch checks and a tested rollback target.
module_guardrails: Pin source SHAs and file-level provenance; dry-run first; create-only imports.
Never execute imported legacy files or modify the legacy source repository.
Keep Astra One as external rescue until native SDA cutover is approved and reversible.
ASEL migration boundary: never copy credentials, live databases or personal data; verify provenance, license, SBOM and signatures before import.

ASEL-1.0 is enforced by deterministic code, not model compliance; scanner exceptions are time-limited and owner-approved; active scanning is non-destructive and limited to inventoried owner-controlled assets.
